correctness.summary: Crelle plus factored Heron gives the normalized slack sum/product identities. A direct disphenoid coordinate construction realizes every positive slack probability vector. The fixed-eta profile is exactly the quadratic discriminant condition for the other two components. The defect formula follows identically from the centroid-circumcenter relation and opposite-edge pairing.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Classical Crelle, d3, Heron, and Mazur inequalities are excluded. No located source states the slack-simplex surjectivity, the complete sharp componentwise profile with full attainability, or the displayed exact defect decomposition. Material folklore risk remains because the deductions are elementary.

value.summary: The result gives a complete quantitative strict-Ptolemy profile for tetrahedra at fixed normalized RV data and proves there is no hidden realizability gap, while the companion identity exactly decomposes the classical volume-inequality defect.

limitations: Only nondegenerate Euclidean tetrahedra are treated; degenerate cases appear as limits.
The controlled quantities are opposite-edge-product Ptolemy slacks, not all six edge lengths.
The profile uses the scale-invariant combination of circumradius, volume, and the sum of opposite-edge products.
Originality is to the best of our knowledge; equivalent older folklore may exist.
